description: Materialize an immutable TemplateIconAsset via Gateway from a confirmed iconId. Call after confirming a candidate from search_icons. Requires idempotencyKey to prevent duplicate creation. Idempotent: repeated calls with identical keys return the existing asset without consuming extra quota. Returns canonical SVG string, iconAssetId, and contentHash.

iconId.description: Canonical icon identifier confirmed from search_icons (e.g. lucide:arrow-right).

idempotencyKey.description: Unique idempotency key to prevent duplicate icon asset creation.

name: get_icon

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the SVG content.

title: Get / materialize icon
